nodes.description: Private uint256 random number derived from block.timestamp; the winning guess target.
Public uint256 tracking the contract balance available as prize.
Public uint256 minimum bet amount (0.1 ether) required to play.
Address of the contract owner, initialized from msg.sender.
Public GameHistory[] array recording every game played.
Owner-only function that updates the minBet state variable.
Payable game entry point that records the bet and pays out the whole balance on a correct guess.
Owner-only function transferring an arbitrary amount of ether to the owner.
Payable fallback function accepting plain ether transfers.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, as player and as payout recipient.
Miner-influenceable timestamp (now) used as the source of randomness.
msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) external value transfer triggered by a player-controlled guess.
owner.transfer(_am) external value transfer of an owner-chosen amount.
New minimum bet value supplied to changeMinBet.
Local GameHistory struct populated with player and guess before being pushed to log.

edges.reason: owner state variable is initialized directly from msg.sender, giving the deployer privileged control.
StartGame reads msg.sender to record the player and to determine the payout recipient.
StartGame recomputes and writes the low-entropy randomNumber after each round.
StartGame updates prizeFund from the current contract balance.
StartGame pushes the recorded game into the log array.
StartGame conditionally executes the whole-balance transfer to the caller on a correct guess.
StartGame generates the next random number from block.timestamp.
The transfer recipient is the untrusted msg.sender, enabling reentrant value extraction.
block.timestamp feeds the keccak256-based pseudo-random generator.
The weak randomness result is stored into randomNumber, making the winning value miner-predictable.
StartGame's outcome depends on now, a miner-manipulable value.
withdaw is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier, which compares msg.sender with owner.
changeMinBet writes the new minimum bet into minBet.
The _newMinBet parameter is assigned to the minBet state variable.
_newMinBet is the input parameter of changeMinBet.
_number is the player's guessed value consumed by StartGame.
The guess parameter is copied into the local gameHistory struct.
The populated gameHistory struct is pushed into the log array.
gameHistory is the local variable declared and filled inside StartGame.
The _am parameter is the transfer amount used in owner.transfer.
_am is the input parameter of withdaw.
withdaw executes the owner.transfer external call.
The owner state variable is the recipient of the withdrawal transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: Local parameter only exists to carry the new bet value into the changeMinBet function body; fold it into the function node.
Player-provided guess parameter is used solely inside StartGame; fold it into the StartGame function node.
Withdrawal amount parameter is used only by the withdaw function; fold it into withdaw.
Temporary struct local created and consumed entirely within StartGame; fold it into the StartGame function node.
